latest.title: Serverless além de Lambda: conciliando API Gateway, SNS e SQS na prática
latest.description: Sistemas serverless de verdade vão muito além de uma Lambda solitária. Neste artigo, vamos entender como combinar comunicação síncrona com APIs (REST e HTTP) através do Amazon API Gateway e comunicação assíncrona com arquitetura orientada a eventos usando Amazon SNS e SQS. Vamos passar pelos conceitos, ver quando usar cada um e desenhar um sistema completo na prática.

latest.title: Centralized egress traffic inspection with third-party firewalls and proxy appliances in a multi-account AWS environment
latest.description: This post shows how to architect centralized egress inspection in a multi-account AWS environment when organizational policy requires third-party firewalls and proxy appliance that does not support GENEVE. It covers how to chain an explicit proxy (fronted by NLB) with NGFWs (behind GWLB) using subnet placement and route table design to deliver defense-in-depth without both appliances needing the same encapsulation protocol.

latest.title: From Content to Connection: Lessons in Storytelling and Public Speaking from AWS New Voices
latest.description: AWS New Voices 2026 transformed the way I approach technical presentations. Through five weeks of learning and collaboration, I discovered the power of audience-first communication, storytelling, strong opening hooks, and memorable takeaways. The program taught me that great talks are not just about sharing knowledge but about creating meaningful connections. In this blog, I share the lessons that reshaped my public speaking journey and how they continue to influence every presentation I deliver.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
